$comment: Tiered term lexicon for the deterministic candidate generators.
This file produces CANDIDATES, never findings. A term appearing here means
'a human should look at this span', not 'this violates a policy'. The Gate
decides, against clause text, whether a candidate is a finding.
The `slur` tier ships EMPTY on purpose. Slur lists are jurisdiction- and
community-specific and go stale badly; populate it from a maintained,
licensed list before relying on AFG-LANG-001, and record the source below.
$obscured_comment: YouTube's guidelines place obscured profanity - bleeping or muting the word,
or covering it with bars or symbols - in the tier that can earn ad revenue.
The lexicon detector therefore recognises these forms and records them as
already-obscured rather than raising a candidate. This is also why `bleep`
is a policy-grounded remediation rather than a guess.
